claimBoundary: CI1-T4 creates a bounded cross-corpus facet/index contract over two pilot packets (CI1-T2 Graphify and CI1-T3 code-review-graph). This model is rebuildable from the cited source packets plus the common search/filter readiness standard. CI1-T4 does NOT claim: a runtime search index, embedding pipeline, vector database, graph execution route, LPCI chatbot, legal advice capability, provider proof, production readiness, hosted readiness, public readiness, or semantic correctness. Semantic correctness remains human review and adversarial sampling work (CI1-T5).
